about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Who are we?
about.description:
Ibis Interactive is a group of video game and visual arts enthusiasts located in Valdivia, Chile. With origins in Global Game Jams since 2020, the group grew and gained momentum in 2023, becoming formalized in 2025.
Ibis seeks to create unique experiences with captivating stories and iconic art.

portfolio.title: Our Games
portfolio.text: A small selection of our games

mainGame.title: Don Pepe y sus globos
mainGame.description:
Don Pepe hosts the hottest game show on air, where contestants from around the world clash in intense water balloon fights.
What started as a simple plan to scam children has become a legitimate sport, and there can only be one winner. Do you have what it takes?

privacy.title: Privacy and Personal Data Policy
privacy.intro: At Ibis Interactive, we respect and protect our players' privacy. We handle data responsibly, securely, and transparently.

collection.title: Information collection
collection.text: Our games do not collect personally identifiable information. We only collect anonymous activity data:
items: User events such as clicks, button presses, or completed levels
Non-identifiable technical information such as operating system or screen resolution

use.title: Use and processing of data
use.text:
Data is anonymized and used internally. We do not sell, share, or transfer data to third parties.
Data is used for:

security.title: Security and confidentiality
security.text: We apply technical and organizational measures to protect information from unauthorized access, loss, or manipulation. Access is restricted to authorized personnel.

rights.title: User rights
rights.text: You may ask what information is collected or request the deletion of anonymous data by contacting us at:

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.text: We may update this policy. Changes will be communicated within the game or through our official channels.
